remarks: Welcome to this beautifully appointed Sterling Homes show home offering approximately 1,561 sq. ft. on an exceptional oversized corner lot with abundant green space and excellent natural sunlight. This impressive home features premium upgrades and designer finishes throughout, including an upgraded kitchen, cabinetry, flooring, lighting and fixtures. The bright open-concept main floor is ideal for everyday living and entertaining, while the upper level offers comfortable bedrooms, a spacious bonus room, and a well-appointed primary retreat. A unique opportunity to purchase the home with the original show-home furniture and furnishings included, providing a truly welcome home experience. The large corner lot offers additional outdoor space, beautiful sunlight exposure and a wonderful sense of openness rarely found in this style of home. (id:67522)
